external_deps: An AI coding agent such as Claude Code, Codex or Gemini CLI

review.tagline: Markdown skill pack and slash commands for the software lifecycle in coding agents
review.summary: A set of 25 SKILL.md workflows covering spec, plan, build, test, review and ship, plus 9 slash commands, 4 agent personas and reference checklists. Skills are plain Markdown with steps, verification gates and anti-rationalization tables. They install into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot and others via the skills CLI or native plugin commands.
review.audience: Developers who want coding agents to follow a consistent engineering workflow
strengths: Installs into 70+ agents with one `npx skills add` command
Each skill has explicit steps, verification gates and exit criteria
Native plugin installs for Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and Gemini CLI
Skills are plain Markdown, usable with any agent that reads instruction files
weaknesses: Slash commands like /spec and /build are Claude Code only; Copilot needs skills invoked by name
Per-skill npx install omits the shared references/ checklists (issue #361)
Cursor and Windsurf need manual copying into rules or skills directories
needs: Needs Node.js (npx), An AI coding agent such as Claude Code, Codex or Gemini CLI
